Linkuva Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Šiauliai County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Until the early 18th century, Linkuva actually had more Jews than the larger city of Šiauliai, and this cemetery originally served Šiauliai's Jewish community as well. The town's synagogue burned down in a fire and was never rebuilt, though the brick Beit Midrash survives. While most of Linkuva's Jews were Zionist, a small number of the town's Jewish youth were active in the Communist underground; in June 1941, some were sent to Šiauliai prison and murdered there on that pretext, while the rest of the community was killed at Juknaiciu forest that August.
